data.title: Meta and Instagram Face Class Action Over Crypto Scam Ads
data.description:
Meta and Instagram face a class action lawsuit over crypto scam ads. According to Foresight News, plaintiffs said they clicked crypto investment ads on Facebook and Instagram, were redirected to WhatsApp, and then transferred funds to fake trading platforms before being unable to withdraw.

The complaint targets product design rather than content moderation alone, alleging Meta's ad system targets users interested in crypto and investing. It also claims scammers can pass ad review if they bid high enough.

The lawsuit cites reports and alleged internal materials, saying the platforms display about 15 billion scam ads per day and generate about $700 million in annual "violating revenue." It further alleges the company weighed fines against ad revenue and did not adequately block the ads. The plaintiffs are seeking an injunction, disgorgement, damages, and a jury trial.

data.title: Serenity Says AI Capital Spending Beneficiaries Have Stronger Fundamentals Than Short Bets
data.description:
Serenity said Jim Cramer recently backed short positions in Sandisk (SNDK), DRAM, and SK Hynix-related stocks favored by AI investor Leopold. According to Odaily, Serenity said Leopold’s AI capital spending beneficiaries have more attractive fundamentals, citing Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix as trading at about 2.8 to 3 times forward earnings for fiscal 2027.

Serenity added that Samsung has signed a long-term agreement running through 2031, while SK Hynix has a minimum-price arrangement. Serenity also said Sandisk is expected to reach a 50% free cash flow margin and an 80% gross margin by 2030. Other AI capital spending beneficiaries held by Leopold include Bloom Energy (BE), Intel (INTC), and AMD, which Serenity said could see a “reverse Jim Cramer” move in the medium term because of strong fundamentals.

data.title: Bank of Korea Survey Sees Rate Hike to 3.25% by Year-End
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, citing a Bloomberg survey, the median estimate showed markets expect the Bank of Korea to raise its policy rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% in the fourth quarter. Markets also expect another 25-basis-point increase in the second quarter of 2027, which would lift the policy rate to 3.50%.

The survey raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 3.4% from 3.3%, and its 2027 GDP growth forecast to 2.5% from 2.3%. It kept 2026 consumer price index inflation unchanged at 2.7% and left 2026 export growth unchanged at 9.2%, while raising 2027 export growth to 4.5% from 3.4%.

Chong Hoon Park of Standard Chartered said the semiconductor boom is continuing to boost household income, consumption, and public finances, supporting faster tightening. He added that inflation expectations remain manageable, while tighter global financial conditions are a constraint. The survey was conducted from September 8 to September 14.

data.title: U.S. Iran War Cost Reaches $33.4 Billion, DoD Report Says
data.description: According to CNBC, the U.S. Department of Defense said the Iran war cost an estimated $33.4 billion as of June 29, and Iranian strikes damaged or destroyed hundreds of buildings and structures at U.S. bases in the Middle East, as well as dozens of U.S. aircraft, by the end of June. The Lead Inspector General report to Congress said the conflict caused $184 million in physical damage to U.S. diplomatic facilities in Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, and that munitions spending created strategic inventory shortfalls and exposed bottlenecks in the industrial base for resupply. The report said a fifth-generation F-35A was damaged by enemy fire for the first time, while four F-15E fighter jets and an A-10 ground attack aircraft were destroyed. Seven KC-135 refueling aircraft were damaged or destroyed, along with seven helicopters and more than 30 drones.

data.title: Thai Vice Finance Minister Says Weaker Baht Will Aid Exports, Tourism
data.description: Thailand’s recent baht decline is set to support exports and tourism, two key drivers of the economy, Vice Finance Minister Santitarn Sathirathai said, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Aave Community Proposes Umbrella Deployment on Aave V4
data.description:
Aave community members have published a proposal to deploy Umbrella on Aave V4, with the proposal submitted by TokenLogic. According to Foresight News, the plan would add an Umbrella coverage mechanism for specific markets on Aave V4, shift deficit risk to independent underwriting suppliers, and account for debt on the Spoke side and asset shortfalls on the Hub side.

The first suggested markets are Core WETH, USDC, and USDT. The proposed parameters are 800 ETH, 400,000 USDC, and 400,000 USDT, with deficit buffers of 33 ETH, 15,000 USDC, and 15,000 USDT.

Umbrella funds in the Hub would continue to serve as productive supply until they are used to burn shares and cover deficits.

data.title: Indian Bonds Fall After Central Bank Announces Sovereign Note Sales
data.description: Indian bonds declined after the central bank said it would sell sovereign notes to drain cash from lenders, adding to debt supply in a year already pressured by record government borrowing, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: House Ways and Means Committee Releases Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act
data.description:
The House Ways and Means Committee released a 114-page crypto tax bill late Monday. According to NS3.AI, lawmakers will debate the measure and vote on whether to advance it at a Wednesday markup hearing.

The bill is titled the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act.

data.title: STANDARD Market Cap Falls Below $30 Million as Token Drops More Than 16% in One Hour
data.description:
Robinhood ecosystem token STANDARD fell below a $30 million market capitalization and was last reported at $28.1 million, down more than 16% in the past hour. According to Odaily, The Standard Reserve describes itself as an on-chain sovereign central bank and says it plans to replace traditional central bank or DAO governance with about 4,000 lines of immutable smart contract code to automate monetary policy.

The protocol adjusts STANDARD issuance based on net ETH flows in Uniswap v4 official trading pools and changes reserve assets, protocol-owned liquidity, and token buyback-and-burn arrangements when funds flow in or out.

data.title: ByteDance CEO Says AI Peak Far Exceeds Previous IT Cycles
data.description:
ByteDance CEO Liang Rubo said today at the Feishu Future Infinite and Doubao Work Kickoff Conference that the IT sector has seen four major development peaks over the past 50 years: PC, Web, Mobile, and AI. According to ChainCatcher, he said the AI peak is far above the previous three.

Liang said such peaks are rare and noted that the intervals between past industry peaks were 15 to 20 years, making opportunities at the industry level especially uncommon.

data.title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop App Appears in Official Repository
data.description:
DeepSeek Harness’s official desktop client has appeared in the main branch of its official repository. According to ChainCatcher, the desktop app is built with Electron and turns the existing Harness Web UI into a standalone application, so users do not need to start a web service themselves.

The codebase already includes build, signing, notarization, auto-update, and upload workflows for macOS and Windows installers, with the production update address pointing to download.deepseek.com. Recent commits mainly fixed packaging, notarization, and startup recovery issues. The official release date has not been announced, and no installer is available in GitHub Releases.

data.title: Base to Add Conditional Transaction Feature in Cobalt Upgrade
data.description: Base senior developer advocate Jon Roethke said Base will introduce a validity transaction feature in the Cobalt upgrade due later this month. According to ChainCatcher, these transactions are EIP-2930 or EIP-1559 types and execute only when specific on-chain conditions are met, supporting conditional transaction workflows.

data.title: UBS Cuts MSCI China Index Year-End Target To 78
data.description:
UBS has lowered its year-end target for the MSCI China Index to 78, citing more conservative valuation assumptions, while keeping its 2026 earnings growth forecast unchanged at 10%, according to Ming Pao.

Bloomberg reported that Wang Zonghao, head of China equity strategy research at UBS, said the revision also reflects lower liquidity, higher global interest rates and geopolitical uncertainty.

data.title: China's August Urban Surveyed Unemployment Rate Rises to 5.3%
data.description: China's urban surveyed unemployment rate rose to 5.3% in August from 5.2% in July, up 0.1 percentage point, mainly because new graduates entered the labor market, Fu Linghui, spokesperson for China's National Bureau of Statistics and chief economist, said at a State Council Information Office briefing on September 15, according to Jiemian News. Fu said the surveyed unemployment rate for the 30-59 age group was 3.9%, unchanged from both the previous month and a year earlier. He added that manufacturing employment remained broadly stable, jobs in information transmission, software and information technology services increased significantly, and employment in accommodation and catering continued to expand on the back of domestic tourism and leisure demand.

data.title: Airbnb Appoints Kong Zhiqiu as Asia Head, He Changhua as China Head
data.description: Airbnb announced on September 15 that Kong Zhiqiu will become head of its Asia business, with overall responsibility for operations in China, Japan, South Korea, India and Southeast Asia. He Changhua will become head of Airbnb China and continue to report to Kong, according to Jiemian News. He will oversee Airbnb's China business, help formulate and implement local market strategy, deepen ties with partners across markets, and strengthen communication with local communities and stakeholders.

data.title: GitLab CE/EE Path Traversal Flaw Rated CVSS 10, Security Patch Released
data.description:
GitLab CE/EE has a critical path traversal vulnerability, CVE-2026-85706, with a CVSS score of 10. According to ChainCatcher, unauthenticated attackers could use the Repository Commits API to read arbitrary files on affected GitLab servers.

GitLab has released a security patch. Affected versions include releases from 18.7 to before 19.1.8, from 19.2 to before 19.2.6, and from 19.3 to before 19.3.2. Self-managed GitLab users are advised to upgrade immediately to 19.1.8, 19.2.6, or 19.3.2 and check logs and any potentially exposed credentials after patching.

data.title: Ult Rebrands From Cronos App, Set to Launch on September 17
data.description:
Foresight News reported that the former Cronos App has been renamed Ult (Ultimate) and will launch on September 17. According to Foresight News, the platform will support spot crypto trading, stocks, commodities, crypto perpetual contracts, sports prediction markets, and deposits through Apple Pay, bank cards, or cryptocurrency on its first day.

Ult said it will not issue a token, and any ULT token is unrelated to Ult, Cronos Labs, or Cronos Network. The company also said all revenue will be used to buy and burn CRO on the open market, with the team planning to carry out the process on-chain monthly and publish transaction details.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Thailand Sees Foreign Investment Surge as Stability Returns
data.description:
Thailand is seeing a surge in foreign investment as political stability and policy continuity return, Vice Finance Minister Santitarn Sathirathai said, according to Bloomberg.

The country had been rocked for years by coups and court-ordered dismissals of prime ministers.

data.title: River Token Unlock Set for September 22
data.description: River (RIVER) is scheduled to unlock about 1.56 million tokens at 12:00 AM on September 22, according to Web3 asset data platform RootData. According to ChainCatcher, the unlocked tokens are valued at about $1.86 million.
